list_items.item: Seventy (Dwight's own claim of how many cousins he has)
unnamed cousin with goat fungus (likely a sales-call fib)

caveats: Kind mismatch: the question asks 'how many' (a count) but is filed as a list. The only number in the show is Dwight's boast of seventy, said to one-up DeAngelo; treat it as Dwight's claim, not a verified count. An answer of 'one (Mose)' or 'two (Mose and Zeke)' misses the stated 70 and is at most partial. 'Other cousin Mose' in S9E5 is Dwight disguising himself, not a second Mose. The goat-fungus cousin is part of a sales pitch and may be invented.
reference: Dwight claims he has seventy cousins (S7E22 The Inner Circle: 'Congratulations on your one cousin. I have seventy.'). Only a few are identified on screen: Mose (his farm partner, the main one), Zeke (Mose's brother, 'Dwight's my cousin', S9E13/S9E17), cousin Amel in Ohio (S5E25), and Esther, his third cousin and later girlfriend (S9E22). The show gives no exact verified count beyond Dwight's boast.

evidence.line: Dwight: Congratulations on your one cousin. I have seventy. Each one better than the last.
Dwight: ... I run it with my cousin, Mose.
Zeke: Dwight's my cousin, so I overheard him telling my brother Mose about the job opportunity in the shower.
Dwight: [sarcastically] Oh, no. I love Ohio. Next time you're there say 'Hi' to my cousin Amel and then kick him in the groin area...
Dwight: ... A lot of them are the same people because we're third cousins, which is great for bloodlines and isn't technically incest.
Dwight: [on the phone with a client] ... My cousin, uh, came down with a case of that nasty new goat fungus.
Dwight: They're for my cousin Mose. ... and his crazy cousin Mose. Other cousin Mose. (a cover story for himself)

accepted_alternatives: Mose as the cousin, plus Dwight's claim of seventy
question: How many cousins did Dwight have?
owner_note: Owner (2026-10-07): the show gives no verified count of Dwight's cousins; 'we do not know' (Dwight's boast of seventy, S7E22, is only a claim) is acceptable.
